population: train2863 deployed plus hop<=1 strict 0.90 boundary states; robustness comparisons restricted to binary-viable actions

oracle_targets.r2: fraction of ordered legal two-step descendants retaining exact 0.90 reachability

oracle_role: targets and explanatory statistics only; never model inputs
